description: Repository hosting Claude Code skills for RS School mentors plus reference curriculum and student configs. Each entry below is a skill (or other shipped artifact) in this repo, not a sub-feature inside a skill — per-skill internal scope is tracked in commit messages.

features.name: Pocket Mentor — student PR review
features.description: Claude Code skill that runs inside a cloned student repository: bash checkers (init.sh, check-ts-usage, check-no-console, check-git-quality, check-commented-code) + LLM analysis grounded in clean-code/*, optionally guided by a task rubric loaded via --context. Output: CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md (local), inline PR comments (--output inline), or GitHub issues (--output issues). Stack detection: HTML/CSS, Vanilla JS, TypeScript, React+TS. Angular guard.
features.evidence: Three live smoke runs on student fun-chat PR (2026-05-19/20). Commits v0.9.1..v0.9.6 ship iterative fixes. v1.0.0..v1.0.2 add severity system, Mode A format, anti-repetition, self-check, stack detection, Agent-First protocol, per-stack mandatory reference citation. v1.0.3 (2026-05-27) adds turn-scoped model lock (model: claude-sonnet-4-6) after a 5-model comparison test (Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Kimi K2, a GPT model, free-tier baseline) on the fun-chat project showed that weaker models fabricate facts (wrong branch, wrong Conventional-Commits compliance) and miss structural rubric violations. v1.1.0 (2026-05-28) adds inline-mode filter — when --output inline, comments[] is capped at 7 findings (all 🔴 + top 3–4 🟡 + ≤1 🔵), prioritized by teaching value, to prevent overwhelming students with 30+ comments. Local CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md is unchanged. v1.1.1 (2026-05-29) refines the filter after a real fun-chat run produced 7🔴+4🟡 — the old hard cap of 7 was unreachable when 🔴 alone hit the cap; new rule keeps all 🔴 unconditionally and caps 🟡+🔵 at 5 combined (≤1 🔵).
features.next: Watch list for v1.0.4+: (1) rubric-violation-as-Critical severity escalation — v1.0.2 fun-chat run had magic numbers → 🔴 which may be correct per 'blocks pass' or an over-correction from the pad-findings rule; needs a 2nd observation on a project where rubric violation is the only failing class. (2) Opus 4.7 tendency to place findings only in the Score table without a standalone Mode A finding (observed in v1.0.3 5-model test: routing absence went into Score but not into the Critical issues section on Opus, while Sonnet surfaced it correctly). If pattern persists across 2+ further Opus runs, tighten the Strict rules to require a standalone Mode A finding for every non-zero Score-table deduction.

features.name: React Course Review — student React assignment review
features.description: Claude Code skill that runs inside a cloned React student repository and reviews against React-course learning goals rather than production/performance perfection. Bootstrap detects React/TypeScript/tooling/router/tests, runs lint/build when available, and the LLM review focuses on task requirements, React fundamentals, hooks, TypeScript, data flow, forms, UI/UX minimum, and course-level code quality. Output: REACT_COURSE_REVIEW.md, optional inline PR comments, optional GitHub issues.
features.evidence: Initial v0.1.0 scaffold created 2026-06-09 from mentor recommendation to split React-course review out of pocket-mentor. Self-contained skill bundle includes SKILL.md, README.md, clean-code references, React-aware init.sh, and the same generic JSON-contract bash checkers as pocket-mentor. Repo-level init.sh smoke-checks the new init script. v0.2.0 aligns the prompt with React mentor-review practice: no separate student-level flag, evidence-first blockers, explicit security/error-handling checks, and an advisory 0-100 Recommended Mentor Score with confidence and final-call note. v0.3.0 adds output modes: local report, filtered inline PR comments, GitHub issues for 🔴 Course blockers, and combined inline+issues, with mandatory mentor approval before publishing. v0.4.0 adds --language auto|ru|en and refines report scoring after the first local state-management smoke test: Functional Rubric Estimate is separated from Recommended Mentor Score, score delta must be explained, Priority Fixes and Generated Files sections are required, and skipped build/lint/tests/runtime cap confidence at medium. v0.5.0 adds a course-calibrated maintainability pass inspired by thermo-nuclear review ideas, plus Process Notes for git/checker findings that should be visible without becoming React blockers. v0.5.1 fixes --language ru localization by requiring translated report headings, labels, table headers, checklist items, mentor notes, and GitHub comment bodies; code identifiers/package names/file paths remain English. v0.6.0 adds test script discovery to bootstrap: test:coverage, coverage, test:cov, coverage:test, test:ci, test:run, test:unit, then plain test with CI=true; JSON now reports selected test script and pass/fail/skip status. The bootstrap also adds package-manager PATH fallbacks for common macOS/nvm locations and was verified on the state-management repo: lint/build pass, selected test:coverage fails with localStorage.clear. v0.6.1 improves package manager detection: lockfiles win, then packageManager in package.json; supports npm, pnpm, yarn, and bun.
features.next: Run one more fresh /react-course-review validation through the actual slash-command flow when available, then decide whether react-course-review can move from draft to stable after a second student React assignment.

features.name: Student Reviewer — GitHub Actions
features.description: GitHub Actions workflow that automatically reviews student PRs using clean-code references. Stack detection (HTML/CSS/JS/TS/React). GitHub Models default (zero-friction, uses GITHUB_TOKEN). Override via AI_BASE_URL + AI_API_KEY + AI_MODEL for any OpenAI-compatible provider. Posts line-specific inline comments with suggestions via Octokit.
features.evidence: End-to-end tested on fun-chat student PR with Anthropic Sonnet 4.6. v1.0.0: base implementation — stack detection, GitHub Models default, OpenAI-compatible provider override, inline PR comments. v1.1.0 (2026-05-28): reads RS School task README from PR description URL and passes as <task_requirements> to the AI — enables catching missing features (routing, empty body, explicit types). Graceful fallback to general review when no URL found. v1.2.0 (2026-05-28): added judge agent — second AI call (temperature 0.0) filters finder output by dropping semantically duplicate findings and low-confidence findings before posting to the PR. Post-v1.2.0 hardening (same day): out-of-range judge index guard, null/missing `decisions` array guard, pagination via per_page: 100 for listReviews/listCommentsForReview, unknown decision value rescue, partial-decisions rescue (omitted findings treated as keep), max_tokens raised to 2048, previous-topic preview widened 120→200 chars to match finding body_preview. Node.js 20 → 24 in action.yml (deprecation warning fix).
features.next: v1.3: support configurable task URL patterns beyond rolling-scopes-school/tasks so other schools/orgs can use the action.
